jobs.prompt:
Use case: compositing. Asset type: landscape promotional artwork for a Qubicode website game card.
Input image 1 is the game's official square Roblox icon, the visual source of truth. Adapt this icon to a landscape 3:2 canvas, preferably 1536x1024. It must unmistakably look like the SAME game and the SAME icon, not a new generic game. Preserve the exact character identity, blocky game proportions, clothing, environment materials, palette, rendering style, and logo treatment where present.
Composition: full-bleed scenery across every edge, no frame, no panels, no isolated square icon, no letterboxing. Expand/rearrange the existing scene to fit landscape. Main action and recognizable subject in the RIGHT half, with the game's readable title logo in the lower-right quadrant, centered around 72% horizontal and 67% vertical, using no more than 46% of canvas width. Leave the LEFT 38% as less busy continuation of the actual environment for the site's separate heading and description overlay. Keep important details and all logo letters at least 7% away from the top, right and bottom edges. Maintain crisp, cheerful Roblox game-art materials, not photographic realism. Do not add UI, badges, labels, watermarks, taglines or unrelated objects. Only the requested game title may appear.
Keep the smiling blocky knight, silver helmet with red plume, red and gold armor, glowing sword, warm sunset and stone ruins.
